translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: and closed in.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: and Arios readied his sword again.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: （Hmm. But my soul friend has also hunted many Majin

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 今現在でしか、物が見れないのかッ……！」
